operating_performance.text: The Paris airports handled {{passengers@FY2024}} passengers in FY2024, while group revenue reached {{revenue@FY2024}} on the wider perimeter that includes TAV Airports and the international airports.
The group extended its Extime retail offering beyond Paris airports with the acquisition of Paris Experience Group and P/S in October 2024.
Following the merger of GMR Airports Infrastructures Ltd and GMR Airports Ltd, the group holds a lower economic interest in GMR Airports.
DIAL filed its tariff proposal for the next Delhi regulatory period, with final tariffs published later and effective in April 2025.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}}, as capital spending absorbed more of the cash generated.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2024}}, which keeps pressure on free cash flow.
Liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, so the buffer against debt service is thinner than a year earlier.

Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@2024}}, and impairment tests on equity-accounted holdings led the group to book a charge.
